messages:
rachel: Quick kickoff for whats-new + changelog: we need owners for snippet updates (py/js/go) and a short known-issues block. I'll draft the blurb but need the snippets patched by EOD.
dev: I'll take JS. Which files?
rachel: docs/sdk/js/quickstart.md, docs/examples/browser.md. Also some anchors under whats-new moved after the headings reorg. doc-bot flagged a few.
doc-bot: linkcheck: 5 failed anchors; full log attached in PR 7011.
mike: I'll do Python + Go. Note: Python changed resp.text -> resp.output.text and param max_len -> max_tokens. I suggest a small compatibility snippet rather than duplicate examples.
dev: For JS I'll rename `new RedwoodClient()` -> `new Redwood()` and add a short migration note. PR 7015 opened.
qa-lee: Tag me when PRs are ready. I'll run smoke on staging (short + streaming long). Pay attention to APAC streaming partials we saw earlier.
rachel: Draft changelog bullets: - SDK: client class rename + param renames (see migration guide) - Docs: anchor reorg + redirects - Known issue: embeddings streaming may produce partial chunks in some APAC zones - Note: legacy alias kept for one release as a shim
mike: Pushed Python compatibility PR 7018 with a tiny shim and a how-to-test block.
dev: Merged JS PR 7015 and added a temp redirect stub for the top anchor to reduce TTL fallout.
doc-bot: deploy: whats-new staging build queued; Netlify redirect TTL ~20-40min may cause transient anchor failures.
qa-lee: Running verification Wednesday 09:00 PT. Include staging link + quick test plan in PR.
rachel: Plan: merge snippet + anchor PRs, QA signoff, then publish whats-new and changelog. ETA EOD Wednesday. Thanks all!
